decisionTree.description: Let users choose how an agent should proceed, with visible consequences, risk notes, recommended branches, and optional follow-up choices.
decisionTree.title: Decisions
decisionTree.reply: Got it. I’ll start with that instruction.
decisionTree.shortcuts: Focus the tree and use the number shown beside an option to choose it. Use ← and → (or K and J) to browse decisions, F to focus the next consequence note, and Escape to close the input, tooltip, or follow-up. In the instruction field, Enter sends and Shift+Enter adds a line.
decisionTree.waiting: {count, plural, one {# waiting for you} other {# waiting for you}}

labels.instruction: Tell the agent what to do instead…

props.decisions: Pending questions with stable IDs, agent details, optional risk, and numbered options. New IDs are appended. An option can have effects or one follow-up question.
props.onChoose: Receives the full selected path or a custom instruction. Return a string to show an agent reply to an instruction. A rejected submission stays in the queue for retry.
props.allowOther: Offer a free-text instruction as the last branch.
props.title: Heading above the tree.
props.labels: Override interface strings and count formatters for localization.
props.ref: Methods for hover, choose, setOther, send, next, previous, and peek. Branch indices start at zero and follow the current step.
props.className: Additional root classes. The layout switches below a 640 px container width.
